jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — French beans (export) manual

varieties.name: Samantha
varieties.supplier_notes: Top export variety to EU; fine pod 9-11cm.

varieties.name: Paulista
varieties.supplier_notes: Slightly heavier pod; tolerates mild rust.

timeline_template.description_en: Plough to fine tilth. French beans need a clean seedbed.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima vizuri. Maharagwe ya mishiri yanahitaji shamba safi.

timeline_template.description_en: Direct-sow seed 3cm deep at 30cm x 10cm. No nursery needed.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu moja kwa moja kina 3cm, nafasi 30cm x 10cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 50kg DAP at planting in the planting furrow.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za DAP wakati wa kupanda.

timeline_template.description_en: Shallow-hoe between rows. Beans dislike root disturbance.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia juu juu kati ya safu. Maharagwe hayapendi kusumbuliwa mizizi.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 25kg CAN side-dressed. Beans fix nitrogen — modest dose.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 25 za CAN. Maharagwe hujishika nitrojeni — dosi ndogo.

timeline_template.description_en: Preventive fungicide at flowering for rust/anthracnose.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya kuzuia magonjwa wakati wa maua.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout for rust pustules and angular leaf spot weekly through pod fill; treat at first sign.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza kutu na madoa ya pembetatu kila wiki wakati wa kujaa kwa maganda.

timeline_template.description_en: Pick pods when 9-11cm long and tender. Snap test: pod breaks cleanly.
timeline_template.tip_en: Pick every 2-3 days during peak. Pods overrun in 24h.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna kila siku 2-3. Magamba huzeeka haraka.

timeline_template.description_en: Continue picks every 2-3 days for 3 weeks total.
timeline_template.description_sw: Endelea kuvuna kila siku 2-3 kwa wiki 3.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Export A: 9-11cm, no blemishes, snap-fresh. Local B: 8-12cm, minor blemishes.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 250g vented punnets for export; 5kg cartons for local market.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cold chain at 5-7°C from harvest to airport. Same-day delivery to packhouse.

diseases.symptoms_en: Orange-brown pustules on leaf undersides, yellow halo, defoliation in humid spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viputo vya rangi ya kutu chini ya majani, mpaka wa manjano, majani huanguka unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered rust-active fungicide at onset. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya kutu mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Aina sugu, epuka kumwagilia kutoka juu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Pustules rub off on fingers — the field test that confirms rust.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark lesions on pods, stems and cotyledons; black seed blotches.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye maganda na mashina; mbegu zenye madoa meusi.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered fungicide at first sign; never save seed from an infected crop. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa mara inapoanza; usihifadhi mbegu za shamba lililoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Pod close-up; the seed-source question improves the advice.

diseases.symptoms_en: Maggots tunnel the stem base; seedlings die or stay stunted with swollen, cracked stems.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viluwiluwi hutoboa shina chini; miche hufa au kubaki dhaifu na mashina yaliyovimba.
diseases.treatment_en: Seed-dress with a registered insecticide; early foliar only in the seedling stage. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Tia dawa kwenye mbegu; nyunyuza mapema tu kwenye kipindi cha miche. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Plant early and dense so the stand outgrows it.
diseases.prevention_sw: Panda mapema na kwa wingi ili mimea iwe imara.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the stem base — leaf photos miss the tunnel.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves in warm-dry spells, leaf burn, weak pods.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Ukungu mweupe majani wakati wa joto na ukavu, majani huungua, maganda dhaifu.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray sulphur-class or registered mildew products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa za kikundi cha salfa au zilizoidhinishwa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Airflow between rows; avoid water stress.
diseases.prevention_sw: Nafasi kwa hewa; epuka mkazo wa maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder on TOP of leaf — distinct from downy mildew.

diseases.symptoms_en: Small water-soaked spots with yellow halos on leaves and pods; worse in cool wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa madogo yenye maji na mpaka wa manjano majani na maganda; zaidi baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — copper-class products suppress spread. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — dawa za kikundi cha copper zinazuia kuenea tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed only; avoid working the field when wet.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa tu; epuka kufanya kazi shambani mvua.
diseases.scanner_notes: Water-soaked spots WITH halos distinguish from angular leaf spot.

diseases.symptoms_en: Brown angular lesions with grey centres, vein-bounded, on leaves and pods.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye katikati ya kijivu, kwenye majani na maganda.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered fungicide class at first lesions. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate crops, clean seed, open rows.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mazao, mbegu safi, nafasi ya kutosha.
diseases.scanner_notes: Angular vein-bounded shape discriminates vs anthracnose.

diseases.symptoms_en: Dark rotting roots, stunted yellow patches, plants pull out easily.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mizizi inayooza, mapande ya mimea dhaifu ya manjano, mimea hung'oleka kwa urahisi.
diseases.treatment_en: No effective spray — drainage is the fix. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna dawa mwafaka — mifereji ya maji ndio tiba. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Raised beds, rotation away from legumes.
diseases.prevention_sw: Vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, zungusha mbali na mikunde.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph an uprooted plant with roots washed.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Export-grade pods fetch a premium over local; packhouse grading rejects swollen pods. Pick every 2–3 days through the 6–8 week window — the picking rhythm IS the export game.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Maganda ya kuuza nje yana bei ya juu; grading inakataa maganda yaliyovimba. Vuna kila siku 2–3 kwa wiki 6–8 — mwendo wa kuvuna ndio mchezo wa kuuza nje.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Local ~60–100 KES per kg; export-grade several multiples (November 2026). Cold-chain discipline (4–6°C within hours of picking) keeps export grade.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Soko la ndani ~60–100 KES kwa kilo; la nje mara kadhaa zaidi (Novemba 2026). Mnyororo wa baridi (4–6°C saa chache baada ya kuvuna) hudumisha daraja la kuuza nje.
